items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then I made a lot of records for Decca, with Rosetta Tharpe.

ctx.x: Well, as a sideman I made records with -- oh, I made -- we would go in the studio, like, with Big Joe Turner, and we would just play until he passed out. We'd make records. And then I made a lot of records for Decca, with Rosetta Tharpe.
